subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft MAP and timeline options (Finovo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finovo.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft MAP and timeline options (Finovo)

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation about Finovo's latency targets and multi-tenant data isolation needs. Per our call, attached is an initial draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to help align on milestones, owners, and target close date. High-level summary below and the full draft is attached and also available here: https://drive.google.com/finovo-map-draft-v1

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Goal: Production-ready Redwood Inference deployment for Finovo core search workflows
- Target close date: 2026-08-14 (suggested; see timeline options)
- Key milestones and owners:
  1) Define technical requirements & data scope (Finovo: Sam Walker) — by 2026-07-07
  2) Security & compliance review (Finovo Sec/Procurement + Redwood Sec)  — by 2026-07-21
  3) Pilot deployment (Redwood Eng + Finovo Eng)  — by 2026-07-28
  4) Performance validation & tuning (joint)  — by 2026-08-04
  5) Go-live & handover (joint)  — by 2026-08-14
- Dependencies: access to a staging VPC, SOC2 evidence, procurement timeline for contract signature
- Risks: delayed procurement approval, longer-than-expected SSO/KMS integration work

Timeline options (choose one):
A) Aggressive — close by 2026-08-14 (requires procurement + Sec review complete by 2026-07-21)
B) Standard — close by 2026-09-01 (more buffer for integration work)
C) Phased — pilot first, then production by TBD if additional compliance gating required

Ask: Can you confirm the Finovo stakeholders for each milestone (especially security and procurement contacts) and which timeline you prefer? Once you confirm I’ll update the MAP and send a version for signature.

Attachment: Finovo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finovo.com>

Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@finovo.com>, Procurement <procurement@finovo.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Draft MAP and timeline options (Finovo)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the email and the clear MAP draft. Solid starting point. A few quick notes:

- Stakeholders: I’ll be the technical owner (milestone 1 & 3). Lydia Chen (cc’d) will lead security & compliance reviews. Procurement (procurement@finovo.com) will own contract timeline and signature. I’ll loop in our infra lead if we move to the pilot.
- Timeline: Option A is possible but tight given our end-of-quarter procurement approvals. If procurement can prioritize, we can go for A; otherwise B (2026-09-01) is safer.
- Dependencies: We need a staging VPC and a brief red-team review window; I’ll get dates from Lydia.

Can you confirm what evidence you need from our side for the security review (SOC2 report, architecture diagrams, data flow)? Also can you add an explicit milestone for contract execution (signature) before go-live?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally and come back with confirmed stakeholder names/titles and procurement timing by EOD Thursday (2026-07-02).

Best,
Sam Walker
Senior Product Manager, Finovo
sam.walker@finovo.com | +1 (617) 555-0133
